summary: Implementation plan for expanding QALA (Desktop & Mobile Liquid Glass super-app) with Qala Food, expanded Taxi tariffs, City Info Hub (rates, eGov guides, reminders), 7-day weather + traffic/Sergek cameras, voice input, mobile bottom sheet drawer + floating mini-player + touch gestures, Qala TV favorites/EPG/PiP/sleep timer + Admin PIN protection, and Light/Dark Liquid Glass theming across both Node and Python backends.
